disclaimer: Values transcribed from the manufacturer's public export-classification table on the checked date. Manufacturers revise these tables; a value here is not a licence determination and does not replace the current published table.

fieldNotes.tppPerGpu: The manufacturer table labels this field TPP per GPU. It is not APP.
fieldNotes.app: APP is requested by BIS for Category 4 computer/system licence applications and depends on the specific system configuration, so it cannot be read off a per-GPU table.
